people.name: Prof. K. Madhu Murthy
people.role: Chancellor (I/c) & Chairman of the Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE).
bio: Prof. (Dr.) Kotha Madhu Murthy assumed charge as Chancellor (FAC) on 18.04.2025. An accomplished academician and administrator, he is currently serving as the Chairman of the Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE). With over 37 years of experience in Mechanical Engineering and Entrepreneurship, he has made significant contributions to higher education policy, research, and institutional development.

Prior to his current role, Prof. Murthy was a Professor (HAG) in the Department of Mechanical Engineering at the National Institute of Technology, Warangal (NITW), where he also served as a Member of the Board of Governors . His leadership roles at NITW included Dean (Faculty Welfare), Head of the Mechanical Engineering Department, and Registrar (Additional Charge). He also held the position of Registrar at NIT Delhi.

Prof. Murthy holds a Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering from Regional Engineering College, Warangal (now NITW), an M.Tech. in IC Engines & Gas Turbines, a B.E. in Mechanical Engineering, and a PG Diploma in Business Administration. His research expertise encompasses IC engines, biofuels, solar energy, and rocket propellants, with numerous publications in reputed journals.

Beyond academia, he has contributed to national policy as an Advisor at the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), focusing on policy formulation, governance restructuring, and curriculum reforms. Internationally, he served as a LEDA Management Advisor for UNDP/ILO in Cambodia and collaborated with Samsung India Software Organization on HR and training initiatives.

A Fellow of The Institution of Engineers (India), Andhra Pradesh Akademi of Sciences, and the Indian Institution of Production Engineers, Prof. Murthy has been instrumental in entrepreneurship and skill development initiatives, establishing incubation centers, and enhancing campus placements. His accolades include the British Council TCTP Fellowship (1996) under the Indo-UK RECs Project, four Best Paper Awards, and a Lifetime Achievement Recognition for his impact on engineering education and entrepreneurship development.

As Chairman of APSCHE, Prof. Murthy is spearheading reforms in higher education policy, academic innovation, and industry-academia collaboration, aiming to build a robust, future-ready education system in Andhra Pradesh.

people.name: Prof. Amarendra Kumar Sandra
bio: Prof. Amarendra Kumar Sandra is a distinguished academician and researcher in the field of Civil Engineering with specialization in Transportation Engineering. He completed his B.Tech in Civil Engineering from National Institute of Technology (NIT), Warangal in 2001, M.Tech in Transportation Engineering from Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Kharagpur in association with TU-Darmstadt, Germany in 2003, and obtained his Ph.D. in Transportation Engineering from Birla Institute of Technology and Science (BITS), Pilani in 2008.

He has over 20 years of experience in teaching, research, consultancy, and industry. He is currently serving as Professor in the Department of Civil Engineering at Rajiv Gandhi University of Knowledge Technologies (RGUKT), Andhra Pradesh. Earlier, he worked in several reputed organizations including GMR Infrastructure, HBS Infra Engineering Pvt. Ltd., L&T-Ramboll Consulting Engineers, BITS Pilani, and Manipal University Dubai.

Prof. Amarendra Kumar Sandra has extensive expertise in pavement engineering, highway engineering, airport pavement design, transportation planning, pavement maintenance, and material characterization. He has successfully completed more than 50 consultancy projects related to highways, airports, and transportation infrastructure.
He is a recipient of the Dr. Shanker Dayal Sharma Gold Medal and Institute Silver Medal from IIT Kharagpur. He has published numerous research papers in reputed national and international journals and conferences. He has guided Ph.D. scholars, supervised more than 50 M.Tech projects, and actively contributes to research, consultancy, and faculty development activities.

/about/organization.title: Organizational structure
/about/organization.description: The organizational structure of RGUKT is published as a document on the official campus site.

paragraphs.text: The Ongole campus menu points to the university organizational structure chart. That chart is published by Rajiv Gandhi University of Knowledge Technologies.

/academics/examination-cell.title: Examination Cell
/academics/examination-cell.description: Results, schedules and examination services published by the Ongole examination cell.

paragraphs.text: The academic menu opens the examination cell on its own site. Timetables that the campus publishes with the academic calendar are also listed here.

/nexus/student-cell.title: Student Cell
/nexus/student-cell.description: Student services hosted on the Nexus portal.

paragraphs.text: The official site sends Student Cell to the Nexus login. Results, attendance, registration and grievances are on the student portal.

/nexus/placements.title: Placement Cell
/nexus/placements.description: Career Development and Placement Cell of RGUKT Ongole.

paragraphs.text: RGUKT Ongole has a dedicated Career Development and Placement Cell (CDPC) for its student community, which organizes campus placement and internship opportunities.
On the official site the Placement Cell menu item has no published address. The campus home page points internships and placements at the CDPC site.
The official site opens the alumni cell on the alumni portal.

/nexus/hho.title: HHO
/nexus/hho.description: HHO, as listed on the official campus menu.

paragraphs.text: The official Nexus menu lists HHO without a description or a working link. Nothing further is published on that item.

/information/info-center.title: Info-Center
/information/info-center.description: Information desk listed on the official campus menu.

paragraphs.text: The official Info-Center item does not open a page. Campus contact details, notices and the RTI desk are the published information channels.

/consultancy.title: Consultancy
/consultancy.description: Department consultancy services listed by RGUKT Ongole.

paragraphs.text: The consultancy label in the top menu does not open a page. The campus still publishes a consultancy note that names services from Computer Science, Electronics and Communication, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Chemical Engineering and MME, and a single WhatsApp contact.
The same workshop line is repeated on every card on the official page, so it is not treated here as a separate service.

/admissions.title: Admissions
/admissions.description: Six-year integrated programme for gifted rural youth of Andhra Pradesh.

paragraphs.text: RGUKT admits students after class 10 into a six-year integrated programme. Selection follows a local-best model so that high-performing rural students are not crowded out by statewide ranks.
The Ongole site does not keep a separate admissions section in the top menu. Admission notices are published with campus news, and the university admissions portal carries the current application.

/about/executive-committee.title: Executive committee
/about/executive-committee.description: Executive committee, as linked from the campus quick links.

paragraphs.text: The quick link labelled Executive Committee on the official home page returns the campus home. No separate committee roster is published there. The governing council page carries the published governing body.
